decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - Details of joinery shall be in accordance with the advice given in Technical Note 3 of the Bedford Park Society's handbook for residents and architects.

Condition : 4 - This consent does not permit the demolition or dismantling of any part of the building, or the removal of any internal feature, floor, wall or ceiling surface, except in so far as the alterations and extension hereby approved necessitate the removal of certain parts of the existing structure as specifically shown on the approved drawings.
description: Alterations to the fenestration to the back extension. Alterations to the walls inside back extension. Replacement of the rear living room bay window. Replanning of 1st floor bathroom.
